conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also limited upside potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5%/month growth, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality tech name. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a reasonable balance of risk and reward.
